Achieving operational excellence with AI
Lean Six Sigma and business process management are methods that bring structure to chaotic operations by focusing on quality control and mapping work across departments. Using a clear, repeatable approach like these can help our company streamline processes, reduce errors, and keep work flowing smoothly.
Read more →
Agent confidence on the technical frontier
Enterprise investment in AI is rising fast, and Gartner predicts 2026 will be a key year for aligning AI projects with business goals. As pressure to show financial returns grows, companies are turning to automated AI agents to drive measurable results. This trend could offer us new ways to automate tasks and improve our own ROI.
Read more →
We Need a 'Truth Campaign' for the AI Era
The item points out the need for a truth campaign in the AI era, highlighting the importance of tackling information challenges as AI becomes more widespread. Ensuring reliable and accurate information will be crucial as AI tools become part of our daily operations and communications.

Oculor is a service aimed at finding warm introductions to investors, helping connect people who need funding with potential backers. If we need to raise capital or find investors, using such a tool could shorten our networking and fundraising efforts.
